## Highlights
### Improved
- On iPhone and iPad, setup's Back button sits on frosted glass, so the page scrolling behind it no longer shows through.
### Fixed
- On iPhone and iPad, fixed a crash when a page closed while it was loading another site. - On iPhone, the color picker fits on screen: it opens on the side with more room, and its wheel and colors make way when space is short. - On iPhone Duo, setup's welcome fills the whole screen, including the strip beside the status bar. - On iPhone, every color's picker opens above or below it at full width, with more room around its edges, so the accent color's picker no longer runs off the screen. - Scrolling down a sidebar with long open folders no longer jumps back up, and folders inside them no longer shrink to their title and grow again as they scroll into view.
---

## Highlights
### Fixed
- Downloads follow the Automatic Downloads choice of the site you’re on, including files it serves from another address, such as GitHub release files. A blocked download’s message no longer appears twice. - Chromium pages use your default zoom when they open and keep your chosen zoom as you navigate. - Chromium is updated to 154.0.8037.57 with upstream security and compatibility fixes.
